about: Questions over the 46 Playground seed items, with the items that answer them. Written on Nov 21, 2026, before any tuning. A hit is any listed answer item. 'hints' is what an outside assistant would send with the question (QueryHints). 'seedOnly' questions are left out of the distractor run, because work mail and newsletters among the distractors could honestly answer them.
